about_the_game:
CURSED PROFIT

Greed is mandatory.
Survival is optional.

Cursed Profit is a co-op horror game for up to 5 players where you work for a criminal organisation, stealing valuables from cursed locations to meet strict profit quotas.

Steal too little — you’re punished.
Steal too much — you die.

Every job is a gamble.
Every choice feeds the curse.

STEAL. SURVIVE. ESCAPE.

Each mission sends your crew into an abandoned location to steal valuable loot and extract alive.

The more you steal, the higher your Greed Meter rises — and the more hostile the environment becomes.
Enemies adapt. Pressure increases. Escape narrows.

Profit is required.
Greed is fatal.

THE GREED METER

• Stealing loot increases your Greed Meter
• Higher greed makes enemies smarter, faster, and more aggressive
• Stay too long or push too far and the location turns against you

Greed equals profit.
Greed equals death.

YOUR BASE OF OPERATIONS

Between missions, regroup inside an old train warehouse:

• Accept contracts
• Prepare equipment
• Plan routes
• Board the train when ready

The train takes you straight into danger — and hopefully back.

CURSED LOCATIONS

Explore a variety of abandoned, hostile locations including:

• Asylums
• Manor estates
• Other forgotten places

Each location features procedurally assembled layouts layered with hand-crafted horror moments.

No two jobs are the same.

CO-OP HORROR (1–5 PLAYERS)

• Designed for communication-heavy co-op
• Split up to maximize profit — or stay together and fall behind
• One greedy teammate can doom the entire crew
• Dead players spectate while the mission continues

ADAPTIVE, UNFORGIVING AI

• Enemies react to sound, light, movement, and greed
• Higher greed escalates enemy behavior
• Some stalk. Some ambush. Some wait.

PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR WITH DARK HUMOR

• Minimal HUD and diegetic UI
• Audio-driven tension
• Darkly humorous enemy behavior and voice lines
• Fear and laughter often arrive together

CONTENT WARNING

This game contains psychological horror, violence, intense audio, and disturbing environments.

Take the job.
Feed the curse.
Make your cut.

Wishlist Cursed Profit now.
